work.note: Piccadilly Circus é um cruzamento famoso no centro de Londres. Ele existe desde 1819, quando a Regent Street foi aberta. facts.label: Conselho e obrigação na escola
facts.sub: Use should + verbo base para conselho: You should start today. Use have to / has to + verbo base para obrigação: I have to give my project.

facts.label: Conselho
facts.sub: Use should + verbo base para dar conselho: You should start today. You should write a list. É uma forma gentil de ajudar um aluno ou um colega.

facts.label: Obrigação
facts.sub: Use have to / has to + verbo base para dizer o que é necessário: I have to give my project on Friday. He has to buy paper. Use has com he, she e it.

pages.title: A quiet school · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday afternoon in a quiet school in Cardiff. Rain falls on the big windows. Rui sits alone in the classroom. His teacher Jack comes in. Rui looks worried. Jack wants to help him.
“Hi, Rui! You look worried. What’s the matter?” says Jack. “I have to give my project on Friday, but I’m not ready.” says Rui. “You should start today. First, you should write a list.” says Jack.
